info.name: Marketing CRM API (STORY-2.3.1 + EPIC-3)
info.description: Complete Mockoon environment for Marketing CRM. All routes strip /api via Vite proxy → localhost:3001. Covers auth, leads (admin/marketing), users, categories, sub-categories, services, lead sources, saved views, notifications, and audit logs.
